preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: for each testcase: 2 <= N <= 10^5 and N-1 <= M <= N*(N-1)/2 and 1 <= K <= M
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of friends (N), roads (M), and the road number K satisfy the given constraints.

preconditions.expression: for each road: 1 <= A, B <= N and 1 <= C <= 10^9
preconditions.description: Each road connects two friends (A and B) and has a length (C) within the specified range.

postconditions.expression: for each testcase: output two space-separated floating-point numbers rounded to 5 decimal places
postconditions.description: For each test case, output the distance of point P from friend A and the maximum distance from P to any friend, both rounded to 5 decimal places.
